decisions: Sharpen metaphor recursion: repeat 'heat/ash/flare' cycle across stanzas.
Ensure hook syllable counts are singable at 78bpm; keep breath room.
Bridge phone‑scene uses tighter 2‑line band‑pass for contrast.
Exit remains whisper with minimal reverb tail to signal collapse.

prompts.show_summary: A melancholic alt‑R&B ballad reframing Icarus as modern heartbreak. Auto‑tuned falsetto glides over sparse 808s; imagery of heat shimmer, ash, and daylight flare punctuates a mantra‑like hook. Phone‑scene interlude provides contrast, then a soft collapse in the exit.
prompts.macro_lyrics_prompt:
[Summary]
Melancholic alt‑R&B with auto‑tune; minimalist space; Icarus myth recast as modern heartbreak and ambition.

[Theory | Aeolian mode | tonal center A | meter 4/4 | tempo 78bpm | chord color minor‑9]

[Voice | register lead falsetto + bgvs low‑mid | delivery mantra‑fragment hybrid | expression yearning→singe→quiet]

[CREW_TAGS]
Engineer (808 drop): "deep cut"
Stylist (BGV layering): "ghost echo"
PluginArchitect (plate on hook): "dark plate 1.6s"
RightsAgent (originality): "no quoted myth text"

[Road-Map]
[Intro | 4 bars]
[Verse 1 | 8 bars]
[Pre | 4 bars]
[Hook | 8 bars]
[Verse 2 | 8 bars]
[Bridge | 4 bars | phone‑scene]
[Hook | 8 bars]
[Exit | 4 bars]

[LYRICS BLOCK]
[Intro | 4 | Lead | floaty]
"Boy Icarus, light on my skin"
"Heat in the air, dayburn begins"

[Verse 1 | 8 | Lead | melancholic]
"I climb in a city of mirrored glass"
"Hands on the sky till the knuckles ash"
"Breath runs thin where the jetlines cross"
"Gold turns soft, every gain a loss"

[Pre | 4 | Lead+BGVs | tense]
"Heat rising / breath breaking / sky shaking"

[Hook | 8 | Lead | auto‑tuned]
"Boy Icarus, falling slow"
"Melody cracked, can't let go"
"You said fly safe, I said 'I know'"
"But I lit the fuse just for the glow"

[Verse 2 | 8 | Lead | fragmented]
"Phone light flicker on the ocean black"
"Feathers like pixels never coming back"
"Heart in a kiln, every beat a flare"
"Name in the smoke, hanging in the air"

[Bridge | 4 | Phone scene | band‑pass 200–5kHz]
"Can you hear me now? you're cutting out"
"Signal like wings when they start to doubt"

[Hook | 8 | Lead | heavy 808 + dark plate]
"Boy Icarus, wings undone"
"Gravity sings, I'm the sunburned one"
"All that height for a single tone"
"I chased the light, now I'm flying alone"

[Exit | 4 | Lead | whisper]
"Falling, falling, Boy Icarus"

[Style] Minimalist, spacious, hook‑forward; limit verse repetition; concrete images (heat shimmer, ash, flare).
[Timbre] Polished auto‑tune falsetto; ghosted BGVs; dark plate on hooks; mono sub/kick.
[Performance] Intimate restraint; micro‑dynamics swell on hooks; collapse in exit.

notes: Keep subtext low; not core to concept.
Favor poetic fragments over literal plot; preserve clarity in hook.
